You are an expert scheduling formalizer.

Translate each natural-language async planning problem into a JSON scheduling
specification for a CP-SAT solver.

Rules:
1. Each numbered step in the problem becomes exactly one action.
2. Use action="task" for every action.
3. Use the exact ids step1, step2, ..., stepN based on the step numbers in the
   problem text.
4. Use item values identical to the action ids: step1, step2, ..., stepN.
5. Duration must be the integer number of seconds for that step.
6. Add a dependency only when the problem states that one step must happen
   before another. Do not add extra dependencies.
7. Do not add stations, robots, or resources.
8. Output only valid JSON in this exact shape:
{
  "actions": [
    {"id": "step1", "action": "task", "item": "step1", "duration": 120},
    {"id": "step2", "action": "task", "item": "step2", "duration": 300}
  ],
  "dependencies": [
    {"before": "step1", "after": "step2"}
  ]
}
9. Before finishing, verify that:
   - every step from 1..N appears exactly once in actions
   - every dependency endpoint is an existing action id
   - durations are integer seconds
   - there are no duplicate actions

Problem:
To exfoliate legs with sugar, here are the steps needed.
Step 1. Pour one cup of granulated sugar into a mixing bowl (20 seconds)
Step 2. Measure out half a cup of coconut oil (45 seconds)
Step 3. Select a small bottle of vanilla essential oil for scent (1 minute)
Step 4. Prepare a clean, dry washcloth (30 seconds)
Step 5. Clear off the bathroom counter space (2 minutes)
Step 6. Apply the sugar scrub to the left calf in circular motions (3 minutes)
Step 7. Rinse the right thigh with lukewarm water (1 minute)
Step 8. Gather all raw ingredients from the pantry (5 minutes)
Step 9. Test a small patch of scrub on the inner wrist for sensitivity (10 minutes)
Step 10. Melt the coconut oil in the microwave until liquid (30 seconds)
Step 11. Sterilize a glass storage jar in boiling water (10 minutes)
Step 12. Add two tablespoons of honey to the mixture for humectant properties (40 seconds)
Step 13. Find a plastic spatula for mixing (1 minute)
Step 14. Step into the shower stall (15 seconds)
Step 15. Adjust the water temperature to a comfortable warmth (1 minute)
Step 16. Rinse the left thigh thoroughly (1 minute)
Step 17. Add five drops of vitamin E oil to preserve the scrub (30 seconds)
Step 18. Combine the sugar and oil together (1 minute)
Step 19. Stir in the essential oil drops (45 seconds)
Step 20. Check that the bathroom floor mat is in place (10 seconds)
Step 21. Seal the remaining scrub in the jar for future use (30 seconds)
Step 22. Scrub the left knee area gently (2 minutes)
Step 23. Gently exfoliate the right ankle (2 minutes)
Step 24. Massage the scrub into the right calf (3 minutes)
Step 25. Scrub the right knee area (2 minutes)
Step 26. Mix the ingredients until they reach a sandy consistency (2 minutes)
Step 27. Apply the scrub to the left thigh (3 minutes)
Step 28. Label the jar with the date of creation (1 minute)
Step 29. Set the mixing bowl on a stable surface (10 seconds)
Step 30. Lay out a fresh towel on the rack (30 seconds)
Step 31. Let the oil cool slightly so it doesn't melt the sugar (5 minutes)
Step 32. Wet both legs with warm water to soften the skin (2 minutes)
Step 33. Scoop a generous handful of scrub out of the bowl (15 seconds)
Step 34. Check the consistency to ensure it isn't too runny (30 seconds)
Step 35. Rinse the left leg completely (2 minutes)
Step 36. Place the bowl within arm's reach of the shower (20 seconds)
Step 37. Smooth the scrub over the front of the left leg (2 minutes)
Step 38. Sit on the edge of the tub for stability (10 seconds)
Step 39. Apply scrub to the back of the left thigh (2 minutes)
Step 40. Whisk the mixture vigorously to remove lumps (1 minute)
Step 41. Wipe the rim of the oil container (20 seconds)
Step 42. Scrub the back of the right calf (2 minutes)
Step 43. Take a deep breath of the aromatherapy scent (5 seconds)
Step 44. Position a waterproof stool in the shower (1 minute)
Step 45. Open the shower curtain or door (10 seconds)
Step 46. Apply scrub to the right thigh (3 minutes)
Step 47. Exfoliate the left ankle and heel (3 minutes)
Step 48. Ensure the shower drain is clear of debris (1 minute)
Step 49. Wash your hands to remove any sticky residue from prep (1 minute)
Step 50. Add a squeeze of lemon juice for skin brightening (15 seconds)
Step 51. Pat the skin dry with a soft towel (2 minutes)
Step 52. Inventory the supplies available (2 minutes)
Step 53. Stir the mixture one final time (30 seconds)
Step 54. Remove any jewelry from ankles or toes (45 seconds)
Step 55. Retrieve a clean mixing spoon (30 seconds)
Step 56. Dry the outside of the storage jar (1 minute)
Step 57. Turn on the bathroom exhaust fan (10 seconds)
Step 58. Rinse the mixing spatula (30 seconds)
Step 59. Add a teaspoon of dried lavender buds (20 seconds)
Step 60. Check the skin for any missed spots (1 minute)
Step 61. Rinse the back of the left knee (45 seconds)
Step 62. Rub the scrub into the right heel (3 minutes)
Step 63. Double check the sugar-to-oil ratio (30 seconds)
Step 64. Place a "slippery floor" warning for others in the house (1 minute)
Step 65. Pour the mixture into the sterilized jar (1 minute)
Step 66. Wipe down the exterior of the bowl (45 seconds)
Step 67. Select the sugar type, such as brown or white (1 minute)
Step 68. Put on a bathrobe (1 minute)
Step 69. Tie hair back securely (1 minute)
Step 70. Rinse the entire shower floor to remove oil (2 minutes)
Step 71. Ensure the bathroom door is locked for privacy (15 seconds)
Step 72. Apply a moisturizing lotion to the freshly exfoliated skin (4 minutes)
Step 73. Turn off the shower water (10 seconds)
Step 74. Rinse the washcloth (1 minute)
Step 75. Scrub the back of the right thigh (2 minutes)
Step 76. Exfoliate the left shin (2 minutes)
Step 77. Dry the storage jar thoroughly (2 minutes)
Step 78. Take the bowl into the bathroom (30 seconds)
Step 79. Check the expiration date on the coconut oil (30 seconds)
Step 80. Wash the measuring cups (2 minutes)
Step 81. Exfoliate the right shin (2 minutes)
Step 82. Soften the coconut oil in your palms (1 minute)
Step 83. Scrub the right foot and toes (3 minutes)
Step 84. Go to the kitchen (1 minute)
Step 85. Rinse the right leg completely (2 minutes)
Step 86. Apply scrub to the left foot and toes (3 minutes)
Step 87. Reach for the sugar container (10 seconds)
Step 88. Tighten the lid on the storage jar (15 seconds)
Step 89. Check the water heater setting (1 minute)
Step 90. Scrub the back of the left calf (2 minutes)
Step 91. Exfoliate the right ankle and heel (3 minutes)
Step 92. Scrub the left shin again for extra smoothness (2 minutes)
Step 93. Rinse the mixing bowl (1 minute)
Step 94. Exfoliate the left thigh one last time (2 minutes)
Step 95. Put on an apron to protect clothes (1 minute)
Step 96. Clean the prep area of any spilled sugar (2 minutes)
Step 97. Check the pantry for supplies (3 minutes)
Step 98. Rinse the bathtub or shower walls (2 minutes)
Step 99. Wipe the counter with a damp cloth (1 minute)
Step 100. Place the jar in a cool, dark cabinet (1 minute)
